note: Export side is factually confirmed: 5 dated customs/B-L rows 2021-11 to 2022-09, all ex Nhava Sheva, destinations Iraq (Umm Qasr) and Pakistan (Karachi), B/L numbers captured. HS codes actually shipped are 320009 (synthetic food colours, IDACOL brand) and 280031 (basic dyes) — i.e. Chapter 32, which matches the declared 320419 family but NOT the declared 210690 (food preparations) line; per project rules this is not a rejection ground, the declared HS should be corrected to the factual 3204/3206 range and the 210690 line dropped unless separately evidenced. Domestic supply evidence is missing, not absent: GST/tender/AR sources were blocked (403) or unreachable this session, so domestic_status is declared_only rather than none_found — no trace of domestic supply was found either way. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in the sources reachable; ImportKey free view shows row counts, not values — do not infer tonnage or value from 5 rows). Role: manufacturer (own MIDC Dhatav plant, own IDACOL brand), not a trader. No sanctions/court findings were checked in this pass and none are relevant to the verdict.
